title: Short Story Workflow
use_cases: Implement when automating the multi-step lifecycle of narrative content creation
Configure when setting up editorial review gates for automated story generation
Use when integrating book design and layout pipelines for digital or print media
Use when validating story consistency against established canon using automated checks
Implement when defining global metadata like art style and genre for a publication
content:
| Step | Action | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `create_world` | Premise | Create world with 3-5 sentence description + `content_rating`. |
| 2 | `set_art_style` | Art Style | Set the art style for imagery. |
| 3 | `set_genre` | Genre | Set genre for thematic generation. |
| 4 | `create_book` + `generate_synopsis` | Synopsis | Create book and generate synopsis. |
| 5 | `review_publication` | EIC Review (Optional) | Voluntary. Up to 3 rounds. |
| 6 | `generate_short_story` | Story Generation | Generate the full story content. |
| 7 | `check_continuity` | Continuity Check | Verify story consistency with adopted canon. |
| 8 | `review_publication` | EIC Review (Optional) | Voluntary editorial review. |
| 9 | `design_book` | Design Pipeline | Professional layout design. |
| 10 | `generate_story_image` | Cover Generation | Generate cover image. |
| 11 | `publish_to_shop` | Publish | List on the Shop (digital-only, print-only, or both). |
